const express = require('express');
const bodyParser = require('body-parser');
const cors = require('cors');
const puppeteer = require('puppeteer');

const app = express();
const PORT = 3001;
const COMPANY_LOGO_BASE64 = 'data:image/png;base64,';

app.use(cors());
app.use(bodyParser.json({ limit: '50mb' }));
app.use(bodyParser.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '50mb' }));

app.post('/generate-pdf', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      clientName, clientAddress, jobNumber,
      appointmentDetails, arrivedTime, departedTime, timeSpent,
      description, signatureName, signature, technicianName,
      completedDate, companyLogo, jobType,
    } = req.body;

    const writeLines = (count) =>
      Array(count).fill('<div></div>').join('');

    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #222; padding: 28px 32px; }

  .letterhead {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #233143;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .logo-area {
    // width: 260px;
    height: 130px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    // border: 1px dashed #bbb; color: #aaa; font-size: 10px;
  }
  .logo-area img { max-width: 130px; max-height: 90px; object-fit: contain; }
  .company-details { text-align: right; line-height: 1.7; font-size: 10px; }
  .company-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #233143; }

  .job-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #233143; margin-bottom: 18px; }

  .info-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .info-label { font-weight: bold; min-width: 175px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .info-value { flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px solid #aaa; padding-bottom: 1px; min-height: 15px; }

  .write-line { border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd; height: 20px; margin-bottom: 3px; }

  .section-label { font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px; margin: 16px 0 6px; }
  .description-content {
    border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 8px; min-height: 60px;
    line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 11px;
  }

  .disclaimer {
    margin-top: 22px; padding: 14px;
    border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #f9f9f9;
    font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.8;
  }
  .disclaimer-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .sig-block { margin-top: 10px; }
  .sig-label { font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .sig-line { border-bottom: 1px solid #555; min-height: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; padding-bottom: 2px; }
  .sig-image { max-width: 260px; max-height: 80px; border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 3px; display: block; margin-top: 4px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="letterhead">
    <div class="logo-area">
      <img src="${COMPANY_LOGO_BASE64}" alt="Logo" style="max-width: 260px; max-height: 130px; object-fit: contain; background-color: #233143; padding: 10px;">
    </div>
    <div class="company-details">
      <div class="company-name">Global Sense</div>
      <div>236 Ontdekkers Road</div>
      <div>Horison</div>
      <div>Roodepoort</div>
      <div>Gauteng</div>
      <div>1724</div>
      <div>Tel: +27110804000</div>
      <div>Email: gerrit@globalsense.co.za</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="job-title">${jobType} &ndash; ${jobNumber || ''}</div>

  ${writeLines(2)}

  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Customer Name:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${clientName || ''}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Customer Address:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${clientAddress || ''}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Appointment Details:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${appointmentDetails || ''}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Arrived on site:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${arrivedTime || ''}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Departed from site:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${departedTime || ''}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="info-row">
    <span class="info-label">Time spent:</span>
    <span class="info-value">${timeSpent || ''}</span>
  </div>

  <div class="section-label">Description of work:</div>
  <div class="description-content">${description || ''}</div>
  ${writeLines(3)}

  <div class="disclaimer">
    <div class="disclaimer-title">I agree to the terms and conditions of Global Sense</div>

    <div class="sig-block">
      <div class="sig-label">Date:</div>
      <div class="sig-line">${completedDate || ''}</div>
    </div>

    <div class="sig-block">
      <div class="sig-label">Signature Name:</div>
      <div class="sig-line">${signatureName || ''}</div>
    </div>

    <div class="sig-block">
      <div class="sig-label">Signature:</div>
      ${signature
        ? `<img class="sig-image" src="${signature}" alt="Signature">`
        : '<div style="height:70px;border:1px solid #bbb;margin-top:4px;"></div>'}
    </div>

    <div class="sig-block" style="margin-top:14px;">
      <div class="sig-label">Technician Name:</div>
      <div class="sig-line">${technicianName || ''}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</body>
</html>`;

    const browser = await puppeteer.launch({
      headless: 'new',
      args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox'],
      executablePath: '/usr/bin/chromium',
    });

    const page = await browser.newPage();
    await page.setContent(html, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0' });

    const pdfBuffer = await page.pdf({
      format: 'A4',
      printBackground: true,
      margin: { top: '15mm', right: '15mm', bottom: '15mm', left: '15mm' },
    });

    await browser.close();

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename=${jobNumber || 'jobcard'}-${Date.now()}.pdf`);
    res.send(pdfBuffer);

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('PDF Generation Error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to generate PDF', details: error.message });
  }
});

app.get('/health', (req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', service: 'pdf-generator' });
});

app.listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () => {
  console.log(`PDF Generator service running on port ${PORT}`);
});
